description: Reg. § 1.453-12(d) Example 4 (net § 1231 loss): Example 1's sale in a year with $1,000 of other § 1231 losses. 'A has a net section 1231 loss of $200 ... A's entire $800 of installment gain is ordinary gain ... treated as reducing unrecaptured section 1250 gain. Therefore, A has $2200 of unrecaptured section 1250 gain remaining'. Form 4797 line 17 is the $200 ordinary loss; nothing reaches Schedule D.
